description: This file contains Zod schema validation functions for secret input configurations related to Telegram and Slack integrations, including validation rules for webhook URLs, secrets, and account configurations.

methods.name: forEachEnabledAccount
methods.description: Iterates over enabled accounts in a record and executes a callback for each.

methods.name: validateTelegramWebhookSecretRequirements
methods.description: Validates that Telegram webhook URLs have corresponding secrets configured.

methods.name: validateSlackSigningSecretRequirements
methods.description: Validates that Slack configurations with 'http' mode have signing secrets.
